<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/reports/generate"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Validates that `reportKey` is in the workspace country catalog, enforces the plan transaction limit, inserts a PENDING run, publishes a `reports.generate` task, and returns the run `id` and taskId. Regeneration is always allowed: each attempt is a fresh run and task, and earlier runs stay downloadable (see `GET /reports/history`).
